purpose: Teach: 各人/個々人/同国/番手/会期/座談/顔面/おこなう

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、各人の警備担当を明確にされますね
lines.en: The police do make a point of clarifying each person's security responsibilities, don't they?
lines.style: Measured, observational tone. Even pacing. Slight rising inflection at the end—not a question, but an invitation to agreement. Collaborative rather than challenging.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、個々人の防犯意識を高められますね
lines.en: They also work to heighten awareness of crime prevention at the individual level, I'd say.
lines.style: Steady, thoughtful delivery. Conversational pace. Slight pause before 'I'd say'—thinking along with the listener. Warmly affirmative without being performative.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、同国出身者の犯罪傾向分析もされますね
lines.en: They analyze crime trends even among people from the same regions, don't they?
lines.style: Lower register, quieter commitment on the statement. Even pace. Slight trailing-off—acknowledging the topic is thorough but not sensational. Respectfully factual.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、捜査の番手担当も決められますね
lines.en: They also assign investigation ranks and responsibilities pretty carefully.
lines.style: Firm but not pedantic. Steady pace. Light emphasis on 'carefully'—showing respect for the work being done. Voice level stays conversational.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、国会会期中の警備を強化されますね
lines.en: Security gets reinforced when the Diet is in session, of course.
lines.style: Easy, informative tone. Medium pace. 'Of course' lands lightly—acknowledging what's obvious without condescension. Collaborative air.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、市民との座談会もおこなわれますね
lines.en: They hold community forums with citizens to build that dialogue.
lines.style: Warm, approving undertone. Steady pace. Slight lift on 'dialogue'—showing positive regard for the connection being made. Open, not guarded.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、顔面認証技術を導入されますね
lines.en: Facial recognition technology is being rolled out too.
lines.style: Direct statement. Clean delivery. Moderate pace. Slight rise on 'too'—adding to a list without judgment. Technical but not distant.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、防犯訓練をおこなう日程も決められますね
lines.en: They schedule drill trainings for crime prevention pretty regularly.
lines.style: Warm, easy agreement. Slower pace—almost conversational. Light emphasis on 'regularly'—normalizing the practice. Genuine, not performative.
